frontend self-test

Dev-only page. Nothing links to it; it exists because the frontend is hand-written ES modules with no build step and no Node, so this browser page is the only way to assert that the highlighter and the code blocks behave. Open it over HTTP (the server has to serve /assets/) and read window.__harness: it must say ALL PASS. It asserts that highlighting is lossless and that every line is balanced, and it does that by parsing the output as HTML — markup that only looks like HTML fails the round-trip.
